gui.komaedit.capability.title: Capabilities
gui.komaedit.capability.tweak.auto: the first one of the block
gui.komaedit.capability.hint.extrude: Wheel: up to %s blocks · Right click: same %s
gui.komaedit.capability.hint.tweak: Property: %s · F with empty hands changes it
gui.komaedit.capability.hint.smear_cance: Right click: drop the pending origin
gui.komaedit.capability.replace.desc: Right click swaps the targeted block for the one in your hand and keeps its properties: stairs for stairs, slab for slab.
gui.komaedit.capability.tweak.desc: Right click with an empty hand cycles the chosen property (facing, half, shape…); sneak to go back.
gui.komaedit.capability.extrude.desc: Holding the same block: right click a face to copy the connected layer outwards; left click shrinks it.
gui.komaedit.capability.smear.desc: Right click sets the origin (sneak for the whole row); the second click stretches it along the face axis to where you look.
gui.komaedit.capability.angel.desc: Right click while looking at the air places the block at the chosen distance, no support needed.
gui.komaedit.capability.reach.desc: Reach blocks much further away, up to the server limit.
gui.komaedit.capability.fastplace.desc: No delay between blocks while holding right click.
gui.komaedit.capability.noupdates.desc: Place and break without updating neighbours: floating sand, still water.
gui.komaedit.title: KomaEdit Procedural Studio
gui.komaedit.stage.path.subtitle: Place, move and review the nodes
gui.komaedit.stage.figure.subtitle: What gets built along the path, pillars, arches and bridges too
gui.komaedit.stage.structures.subtitle: Pillars, arches, bridges and torii between two points
gui.komaedit.stage.modifiers.subtitle: Scale, rhythm, twist and terrain fitting
gui.komaedit.stage.material.subtitle: Block, gradient and how it is spread
gui.komaedit.stage.instances.subtitle: Reopen and edit what you already built
gui.komaedit.stage.recipes.subtitle: Save, load and share setups
gui.komaedit.stage.color.subtitle: Gradients, similar blocks and shading
gui.komaedit.build_large: Large build: ≈ %s blocks · press Build again within 5 s to confirm
gui.komaedit.help.build: Builds the recipe along the path (B). Builds over 250,000 blocks ask for a second press.
gui.komaedit.search.empty: No results · try another name or a command alias
gui.komaedit.search.typing: Type to filter · Enter picks the first · Esc clears
gui.komaedit.help.favorite_star: ★ on the right: add to or remove from favorites
gui.komaedit.preset.compact.help: Smaller and tighter: radius ×0.6 and one step less spacing.
gui.komaedit.preset.default.help: Back to the figure's default proportions, keeping options and modifiers.
gui.komaedit.preset.wide.help: Bigger and looser: radius ×1.5 and one step more spacing.
gui.komaedit.preset.bold.help: Radius ×1.2 and one more point of thickness.
gui.komaedit.preset.random.help: Seeded variant around the default proportions (R). Z undoes it.
gui.komaedit.variant.applied: Variant #%s · R for another, Z to go back
gui.komaedit.hologram.hidden: Hologram hidden · H shows it again
gui.komaedit.number.typing: Type the value · Enter applies, Esc cancels
gui.komaedit.number.invalid: Invalid value · the previous one is kept
gui.komaedit.reset_done: Default value restored · Z undoes it
gui.komaedit.help.cycle: Wheel or ‹ › to change · right click: default
gui.komaedit.help.radius: Main size of the figure in blocks: radius, amplitude, scale or thickness depending on the figure. It changes the block count the most.
gui.komaedit.help.spacing: Spacing or repetition of the motif: spacing, sides, strands, symmetry or frequency depending on the figure.
gui.komaedit.help.thickness: Thickness of the piece: tube wall, strand, core or relief depending on the figure.
gui.komaedit.help.roll: Rotation of the section around the path, in degrees.
gui.komaedit.help.height: Height of the structure or spacing of the clouds, in blocks.
gui.komaedit.help.dither: Organic mix between gradient blocks: 0 gives clean bands, 100 mixes a lot.
gui.komaedit.help.start_scale: Figure scale at the start of the path, in %% of the normal value.
gui.komaedit.help.end_scale: Figure scale at the end of the path, in %%.
gui.komaedit.help.start_spacing: Spacing at the start of the path, in %%.
gui.komaedit.help.end_spacing: Spacing at the end of the path, in %%.
gui.komaedit.help.twist: Total twist the figure accumulates from start to end, in degrees.
gui.komaedit.help.rhythm_interval: Every how many segments the secondary fusion figure appears.
gui.komaedit.help.conform_radius: How far surface conform searches for terrain, in blocks.
gui.komaedit.help.surface_offset: Gap between the figure and the conformed surface, in blocks.
gui.komaedit.help.socket_interval: Every how many blocks the clipboard module is placed (kitbash).
gui.komaedit.help.option.engine: Classic engine (brushes, as always) or exact (no gaps, with ends, normals and pieces).
gui.komaedit.help.option.preset: Built-in formula of the Expression figure. From a custom formula, the first click goes back to the built-in one.
gui.komaedit.help.option.hollow: Solid or hollow; when hollow, thickness sets the wall.
gui.komaedit.help.option.end: How the tube ends are closed.
gui.komaedit.help.option.normal: Where the section faces in curves: continuous, horizontal or upright.
gui.komaedit.help.option.smooth: Full blocks, or slabs and stairs on the surface.
gui.komaedit.help.option.coverage: How much of the surface becomes pieces: higher means more slabs and stairs.
gui.komaedit.help.option.socket_placemen: How the clipboard module is placed along the path.
gui.komaedit.help.top.hologram: Show or hide the hologram (H); the block count is still computed
gui.komaedit.help.top.undo: Undo Studio setting (Z); the world is undone with Ctrl+Z
gui.komaedit.shortcuts.title: Studio shortcuts
gui.komaedit.shortcuts.close: Esc, F1 or click to close
gui.komaedit.shortcut.stage: Go to a stage (in side bar order)
gui.komaedit.shortcut.build: Build (large builds ask to confirm; in Tools, the chosen tool)
gui.komaedit.shortcut.variant: Random seeded variant (in Tools, a new seed)
gui.komaedit.shortcut.wheel: Over the buttons or value: change it; elsewhere: scroll
gui.komaedit.shortcut.big_step: Big steps with − + or the wheel
gui.komaedit.shortcut.drag: On a number: drag to change it (with Shift, fine) and click to type it
gui.komaedit.path.how.click: Click the world: adds a node where the mouse points.
gui.komaedit.path.how.move: Click a node (or the list) and drag its X, Y, Z arrows to move it.
gui.komaedit.path.how.camera: Right click and drag turns the camera; W, A, S, D move you.
gui.komaedit.help.path.add_here: Adds a node where you stand (like /komaedit path here).
gui.komaedit.help.path.toggle_closed: A closed path joins the last node to the first (needs 3).
gui.komaedit.help.path.clear: Removes every node (Ctrl+Delete). The world is not changed.
gui.komaedit.help.formula: Click to type the formula · Enter applies, Esc cancels, Ctrl+V pastes.
gui.komaedit.help.option.easing: How the curve moves from start to end.
gui.komaedit.modifiers.intro: Optional: they do not move the points. They deform the figure from start to end, mix in another one or stick it to the terrain.
gui.komaedit.help.fusion: Overlays the secondary figure every N segments of the path.
gui.komaedit.help.kitbash: Places the WorldEdit clipboard along the path (computed when building).
gui.komaedit.help.close_gaps: Fills the one-block gaps that tight curves leave.
gui.komaedit.help.remove_isolated: Removes blocks left floating with no neighbours.
gui.komaedit.material.library_hint: The library has every registered block, other mods included.
gui.komaedit.blocks.title: Block library
gui.komaedit.color.shade_hint: Recolors the surface of the //pos1 //pos2 selection by light: faces towards it get lighter, corners and shadows darker. Stairs and slabs keep their shape. //undo reverts it.
gui.komaedit.help.color.pick: Pick the block from the catalog.
gui.komaedit.help.color.steps: Blocks in the gradient, counting both ends.
gui.komaedit.help.color.cubes: Only full, solid, opaque blocks: no slabs, glass or leaves.
gui.komaedit.help.color.anything: Lets ores, glazed terracotta, machines and light sources in.
gui.komaedit.help.color.to_hotbar: Puts the gradient in your hotbar (creative; can be undone).
gui.komaedit.help.color.another: Tries other blocks while staying close to the color.
gui.komaedit.help.color.to_chat: Prints it in chat, with buttons to save it as a palette.
gui.komaedit.help.color.light: Where the light comes from. Compass points come in at 45°.
gui.komaedit.help.color.palette: From the selection uses its materials dark to light; the ramp builds tones around the main material.
gui.komaedit.help.color.dither: Mixes neighboring palette blocks at the transitions so there are no bands.
gui.komaedit.instance.empty: Nothing built yet. Every new Build will show up here.
gui.komaedit.help.instance.update: Rebuilds the instance with the current settings, on its original path.
gui.komaedit.recipe.name: recipe_name
gui.komaedit.recipe.empty: No recipes yet. Set up a figure and press Save.
gui.komaedit.help.recipe.name: Letters, numbers, _ and -. It also names what you build.
gui.komaedit.help.recipe.export: Saves the recipe to config/komaedit/packages to share it.
gui.komaedit.hologram.server_adjusted: Base hologram · terrain and kitbash are completed when building
gui.komaedit.status.engine.exact: Exact engine · no gaps, with ends, normals and pieces
gui.komaedit.status.engine.classic: Classic engine · the figure is stamped with brushes
gui.komaedit.status.formula.typing: Type the formula · Enter applies, Esc cancels, Ctrl+V pastes
gui.komaedit.status.formula.custom: Custom formula applied · whatever gives > 0 is built
gui.komaedit.status.profile.sides: Profile %s · Sides / points sets how many
gui.komaedit.status.hollow.on: Hollow tube · Wall sets the thickness in blocks
gui.komaedit.status.normal.consistent: Continuous normals · the section rolls smoothly through curves
gui.komaedit.status.normal.horizontal: Horizontal normals · the top face keeps facing the sky
gui.komaedit.status.normal.upright: Upright normals · the section stays aligned with the Y axis
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.slabs: Slabs on the surface · same material as the pattern
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.stairs: Slabs and stairs on the surface · Coverage decides how many
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.stairs2d: Straight slabs and stairs · corners only where Minecraft forces them
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.layers: Snow layers on the ground · 1/8 block steps
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.ssw: Slabs, stairs and walls · walls for thin columns
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.panes: Panes · glass panes or iron bars joined to their neighbours
gui.komaedit.status.coverage.full: Coverage 100%% · the whole surface gets pieces
gui.komaedit.status.modifiers.reset: Modifiers reset · a single clean figure
gui.komaedit.status.fusion.on: Fusion on · the secondary figure is overlaid at intervals
gui.komaedit.status.kitbash.on: Kitbash on · it will use the WorldEdit clipboard
gui.komaedit.status.node.selected: Node %s selected · drag an X, Y or Z arrow
gui.komaedit.status.instance.updated: Update sent · keeps the original path
gui.komaedit.status.instance.selected: Instance picked · change settings and press Update
gui.komaedit.status.build.sent: Build sent · the points stay until you press Clear
hud.komaedit.path.title: KomaEdit · path capture
hud.komaedit.path.hint: K opens the Studio  ·  P ends capture  ·  /ke path points
komaedit.shape.spiked_scales.description: Separate diamonds with a raised spike and a solid core
komaedit.shape.beads.description: Rounded volumes spaced along the path
komaedit.shape.coil.description: Continuous helix like a spring, cable or root
komaedit.shape.lightning.description: Jagged 3D bolt with branches; closed, it makes a hollow crown
komaedit.shape.crowns.description: Toothed floral loops with alternating rotation
komaedit.shape.fishnet.description: Mesh of crossed helical threads wrapping the path
komaedit.shape.oscillate.description: Volumetric ribbon that waves and turns
komaedit.shape.ribloops.description: Repeated open arches with a lengthwise spine
komaedit.shape.tiles.description: Tilted square plates wrapping the path
komaedit.shape.hexarmor.description: Raised hexagonal panels over a tubular skin
komaedit.shape.voronoi.description: Organic mesh of irregular cells with depth
komaedit.shape.knots.description: Alternating toroidal knots for biomechanical surfaces
komaedit.shape.noodles.description: Bundle of crossed, textured organic tubes
komaedit.shape.clouds.description: Cloud volume with masses, lobes, crowns and eroded trails
komaedit.shape.web.description: Thin bridge between thick knots, or a classic web of spokes and arcs
komaedit.shape.sweep.description: 2D profile (circle, star, rope…) swept in tube space, watertight and without bridges
komaedit.shape.braid.description: Figure-eight strands crossing over and under along the path
komaedit.shape.noisetube.description: Solid tube whose crust is bitten by 3D noise that follows the curve
komaedit.shape.expression.description: Figure defined by a formula in tube space: x and y across the section, z along it
komaedit.shape.pillar.description: Epic column between P1 and P2 with base, shaft, ribs and capital
komaedit.shape.pillararches.description: Two monumental pillars from P1 and P2 joined by an ornate arch
komaedit.shape.torii.description: Giant Japanese gate with leaning pillars, curved beams, brackets and a central plaque
komaedit.shape.archbridge.description: Walkable bridge with an arch, parapets and ribs
komaedit.metric.axis.help: Spreads the palette along the chosen axis.
komaedit.metric.exposure.help: What faces the sky and open air gets the end of the palette.
komaedit.metric.cavity.help: Corners and hollows darken with the start of the palette.
komaedit.metric.edges.help: Ridges and edges stand out with the end of the palette.
komaedit.metric.curvature.help: Separates convex areas from concave ones.
komaedit.metric.organic.help: Soft noise patches, like natural stone or moss.
komaedit.metric.figure.help: Local pattern adapted to the figure's geometry.
komaedit.metric.motif.help: Restarts the gradient between the root and the front of each motif.
komaedit.metric.relief.help: Separates core, depth and raised areas.
komaedit.metric.alternate.help: Alternates two palette ranges between consecutive rows.
komaedit.formula.windows.description: Tube with n windows per turn and a continuous floor
komaedit.formula.rails.description: Two rails on sleepers, like a track
komaedit.formula.stripes.description: Solid core with n raised spiral stripes
komaedit.formula.lattice.description: Skin of diagonally crossed bars, n per turn
komaedit.formula.ribs.description: Rings every 6/n radii joined by a keel
komaedit.symmetry.center.none: not set (it goes where you stand when you turn it on)
komaedit.symmetry.worldedit.on: Your WorldEdit and KomaEdit edits are mirrored too, in the same //undo
komaedit.symmetry.worldedit.off: Your WorldEdit and KomaEdit edits are no longer mirrored
komaedit.symmetry.hover.on: Turns symmetry on with this center
komaedit.symmetry.hover.here: Center on the block you stand in
komaedit.symmetry.hover.half: Center on the nearest edge between blocks
komaedit.symmetry.hover.selection: Center on the middle of the WorldEdit selection
komaedit.symmetry.hover.worldedit: Mirror your WorldEdit and KomaEdit edits too
komaedit.symmetry.warn.radial: Warning: in radial mode the center must be on a block in both X and Z, or between blocks in both; otherwise some copies skip blocks. Use center here or center here half xz
komaedit.symmetry.warn.world: The symmetry is in %s and does nothing here; use center here to bring it
komaedit.symmetry.missed: Symmetry · %s of %s copies not made (occupied, protected area or outside the world)
komaedit.symmetry.limit: Symmetry · copies stopped at %s blocks: that is the limit per edit
gui.komaedit.stage.tools.subtitle: Trees, roofs, terrain, utilities, symmetry and capabilities
gui.komaedit.shortcut.cancel_job: Cancel what is running or discard the preview
gui.komaedit.job.confirm.help: Applies exactly what the preview shows (/komaedit confirm). Shortcut: Enter.
gui.komaedit.job.discard.help: Discards the preview without touching the world (/komaedit cancel). Shortcut: Ctrl+Backspace.
gui.komaedit.job.cancel.help: Stops reading, calculating or placing (/komaedit cancel). What was already placed stays in a single //undo. Shortcut: Ctrl+Backspace.
gui.komaedit.tools.search.help: By name, command, alias or description. Enter picks the first one; Esc clears.
gui.komaedit.tools.favorites.empty: Mark tools with the ★ to see them here
gui.komaedit.tools.command.help: Click: copy the command to the clipboard. Build sends exactly this command.
gui.komaedit.tools.block.help: Click: pick from the block library · Right click: back to the default
gui.komaedit.tools.preview.help: Build asks for the universal preview: it is shown in the world and waits for Confirm or Discard in the footer. Applies to every tool that supports it.
gui.komaedit.tools.random.help: New random seed; every other setting stays the same (R).
gui.komaedit.tools.biome.none: The world has not sent its biomes yet
gui.komaedit.tools.target.look: Placed where you click in the world (without a click, at the center of the screen).
gui.komaedit.tools.target.path_or_look: One at each path point or, without points, where you click.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.path_or_look.n: No points: click in the world where it goes and drag the ghost to move it.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.path_or_look.p: One at each of the %s path points.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.path_or_select: Follows the path or, without one, the WorldEdit selection.
Mark path points (P) or a selection with //pos1 and //pos2.
No path: uses the WorldEdit selection.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.selection.none: Works on the WorldEdit selection, and there is none right now.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.hand: Goes to a brush in your hand: right click in the world to use it.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.mode: A mode that stays on until you turn it off.
gui.komaedit.tools.status.bad_name: The name takes 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, _ or -
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.no_selection: Select the area first with //pos1 and //pos2 (or the WorldEdit wand)
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.no_path_or_se: Mark at least two path points (P) or select from //pos1 to //pos2
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.loft_points: Mark at least %s points (each curve in a row) or type saved paths
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.illegal_chara: “%s” has a character the chat does not accept (§ or control)
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.curve_name: “%s” is not a path name (letters, digits, _ and -)
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.curve_count: Type 2 to 6 saved paths, or none to use the points
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.stamp_name: “%s” is not a stamp name (letters, digits, _ and -)
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.drops: Hydraulic erosion accepts up to %s drops per column
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.thermal_stren: Thermal erosion strength goes from 0.1 to %s
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.creative_only: Capabilities only work in creative (or with komaedit.admin.anymode)
gui.komaedit.tools.action.brush.help: Puts these settings on a brush in your hand: every right click places a new one.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.save_preset.he: Saves these settings under a name (#name) to use them later.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.estimate.help: Estimate only: blocks, chunks, box, memory and time (-e). Changes nothing.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.center_here.he: Puts the center on the block you stand on.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.center_half.he: Puts the center on the nearest edge between blocks: even-width builds.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.center_selecti: Puts the center in the middle of the WorldEdit selection.
gui.komaedit.tools.param.heading: Lean heading
gui.komaedit.tools.placeholder.curves: empty: current points · e.g. edge1 edge2
gui.komaedit.tools.placeholder.custom: name of a PNG in config/komaedit/heightmaps
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.young.help: Short, thin and with a small crown.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.old.help: Thick trunk, wide crown, more branches and more twisted.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.windswept.help: Leaning 25° with twisted branches, like on a windy cliff.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.with_dormers.h: Gable with two dormers per long eave.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.mountain.help: Radius 24 mountain at its natural height, turned at random.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.hills.help: Rolling hills in maximum mode: go over the same spot without them piling up.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.dunes.help: Dune field with sand (its category's palette).
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.monument.help: Size 16 letters, 3 deep, with border and slabs and stairs.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.dusting.help: One even layer, no drifts in hollows.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.drifts.help: Three layers that pile up in hollows and shade, covering grass.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.peaks.help: More snow the higher it is.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.description: Procedural tree with a tapering trunk, self-distributing branches, roots and a lumpy crown. /komaedit tree
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.species: How it grows and its default materials.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.height: Height in blocks; auto uses the species height.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.thickness: Trunk thickness and, with it, every branch (-g).
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.heading: Lean heading: 0 east, 90 south; auto is random.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.curvature: How much trunk and branches meander (-c).
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.seed: Same seed, place and settings: the same tree (-s). Auto picks a new one each time.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.trunk: Trunk and branches (-t); several blocks make streaks.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.roots: Roots gripping the ground (-r no removes them).
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.root_block: Root material; defaults to the trunk.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.variation: Variation between trees on several points or with the brush (-x).
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.mask: WorldEdit mask: where it may place blocks (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.description: Faceted, cracked and shaded rock sunk into the ground; or a crag or spire. /komaedit rock
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.type: Rounded boulder, layered crag or spire.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.size: Radius in blocks; auto uses the type size.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.seed: Seed (-s); auto picks a new one each time.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.palette: Blocks from dark to light, comma separated, or ##palette (-b).
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.moss: How much moss on top and in nooks (-u).
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.variation: Variation between rocks on several points or with the brush (-x).
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.mask: WorldEdit mask: where it may place blocks (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.description: Full roof over the selection footprint, with stairs, corners and slabs placed right. Select at the height of the wall tops. /komaedit roof
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.material: Full block; stairs and slabs come from its family.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.overhang: How far it sticks out past the walls (-a).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.dormers: Dormers per straight eave of 9 blocks or more (-b).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.wall: Gables, dormer walls and parapet (-m); defaults to the walls.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.side: Low side of a shed roof (-lado).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.height: Dome, cone, spire or pagoda height (-h).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.break: How far the steep slope or end hips reach (-q).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.detect: The footprint comes from the walls inside the selection (-d).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.replace: Also replaces what is not air (-r).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.description: Surface stretched between 2 and 6 curves: awnings, sails, tarps or hanging bridges. /komaedit loft
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.material: Block or palette, as a gradient from the first curve to the last.
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.interpolati: How it goes from one curve to the next (-i).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.sag: How much the middle of each span sags; auto is 15%% of the span (-comba).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.profile: Slabs and stairs on the surface (-w).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.closed: Joins the last curve to the first (-cerrar).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.curves: Paths saved with /komaedit path save, separated by spaces.
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.count: How many curves the current points are split into (-n).
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.description: Brush that stamps relief on every click: 80 stamps in 14 categories (mountains, canyons, dunes, islands…), each click a little different. /komaedit pincel heightmap
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.stamp: The shape to stamp. Pick a category or type in the search; the star keeps it in your favourites.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.custom: Uses your own PNG from config/komaedit/heightmaps instead of the gallery.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.radius: Half the stamp side in blocks.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.height: Blocks the highest point of the stamp rises. On automatic, the stamp's natural height for that radius.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.mode: Add raises the shape; subtract removes it; maximum raises it without sinking what is already higher; flatten sets the ground to the stamp; smooth blends edges and seams. Left click does the opposite.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.palette: Blocks for what changes, by slope and height. "The category's": snow on mountains, sand on dunes, strata on mesas…
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.intensity: Share of the shape on each click (-i).
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.neutral: Gray that changes nothing (-c); auto uses the stamp value.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.brush_prev: Each click leaves its brush preview (-p).
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.description: Ramp from the first to the last point (or //pos1 to //pos2): fills below and cuts above, without steps. /komaedit terreno rampa
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.help.profile: Flat section with a transition, or embankment.
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.help.transition: Strip blending the ramp into the ground on each side.
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.help.talus: Blocks the talus rises per block (-t).
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.help.mask: WorldEdit mask on the surface block (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.river.description: Carves a channel along the path, with soft banks and water that never climbs. /komaedit terreno rio
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.walls: Blocks the slope rises per block (-w).
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.smoothing: Length of the bed moving average (-z).
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.follow: The bed follows the point heights (-y).
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.mask: WorldEdit mask on the surface block (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.description: Physical erosion of the selection: drops carving channels, slopes crumbling, or both. /komaedit terreno erosion
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.help.strength: How much each drop or pass carries.
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.help.mask: WorldEdit mask on the surface block (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.description: Repaints the selection surface with the palette without changing any height. /komaedit terreno pintar
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.palette: Grass on flats, stone on slopes, snow on top…
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.mask: WorldEdit mask on the surface block (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.description: Text in blocks with font, border and slabs and stairs, where you click. Never removes blocks. /komaedit text
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.font: Built-in fonts and those in config/komaedit/fonts (-f).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.size: Height of a capital letter in blocks (-s).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.border: Border around the letters; 0 for none (-b).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.orientation: Standing (-v), lying (-h) or by your view.
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.profile: Slabs and stairs on the edges (-w).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.mask: Only where the mask accepts, e.g. air (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.analyze.description: Counts the selection blocks and their survival cost; the list shows here and in a CSV. /komaedit analyze
gui.komaedit.tools.analyze.help.lines: Lines shown in chat (-n); all of them show here.
gui.komaedit.tools.gravity.description: Drops the selection blocks by columns, like sand, keeping their order. /komaedit gravity
gui.komaedit.tools.gravity.help.mask: Only blocks the mask accepts fall (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.snow.description: Snow layers that follow the slope and pile up in hollows and shade. /komaedit snow
gui.komaedit.tools.snow.help.radius: Slope smoothing (-r); 0 is an even blanket.
gui.komaedit.tools.snow.help.height: Extra layers at the top of the selection (-h).
gui.komaedit.tools.snow.help.plants: Also covers short grass and ferns (-p).
gui.komaedit.tools.snow.help.mask: Only on blocks the mask accepts (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.drain.description: Removes water, lava or both from the selection and unwaterlogs blocks. /komaedit drain
gui.komaedit.tools.waterlog.description: Floods below a level: waterlogs what accepts water and fills the air with still water. /komaedit waterlog
gui.komaedit.tools.waterlog.help.offset: Blocks above or below your feet.
gui.komaedit.tools.waterlog.help.blocks_: Only waterlogs blocks, without filling air (-b).
gui.komaedit.tools.biome.description: Changes the selection biome (datapack and mod ones too); visible without rejoining. /komaedit biome
gui.komaedit.tools.biome.help.biome: Type to search the server biomes.
gui.komaedit.tools.biome.help.vertical: Paints each cell column from the world bottom to the top (-v).
gui.komaedit.tools.biome.help.mask: Only cells with a block the mask accepts (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.description: Every block you place or break by hand is repeated in its symmetric copies, with the state mirrored. /komaedit symmetry
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.help.mode: Mirrors in X, Z, Y or their combinations, or radial.
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.help.mirror_: Adds the up ↔ down mirror to the radial (radial n y).
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.descript: Hand-building capabilities, like the Z menu: replace, tweak, extrude, smear, place in the air, long reach, fast place and no updates.
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.center_elsew: The center is in another dimension: %s
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.no_center: No center: turning it on uses your block
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.worldedit.he: Your WorldEdit and KomaEdit edits (//set, //paste, Build, brushes…) also write their copies, in the same //undo.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.unavaila: The server has not sent the capability state yet.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.family.h: Replace changes the material and keeps the shape: with spruce in hand, an oak stair becomes a spruce stair.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.match.he: Block type or exact state when looking for the layer to extrude.
gui.komaedit.tools.materials.none: Press Count: the selection list will show here.
gui.komaedit.tools.materials.total: %s blocks · %s types · in survival %s items, %s slots ≈ %s chests
